$comment: Fili.VSCode2026 Light. Every role is [value, provenance]. Provenance names the Visual Studio 2026 (18.x) theme token the value comes from (Category.Token, decoded from Theme.Light.pkgdef, or 'VS default' where the Light theme inherits the editor's built-in colour), 'sampled' for a pixel read off a live VS 2026 Light window, 'composite' for a translucent Fluent token flattened onto the surface it sits on, or 'inferred' where VS has no equivalent. Designed from the Light references, not inverted from dark.json, but role names must match it exactly.
name: Fili.VSCode2026 Light

chrome: ShellInternal.EnvironmentBackground (frame, title bar, menu bar, toolbar; sampled identical)
card: ShellInternal.EnvironmentTab (document and tool-window cards; sampled identical)
tabWell: sampled: tab strip behind inactive document tabs
editor: VS default Plain Text background (sampled identical)
navbar: sampled: editor navigation bar (project / type / member dropdowns)
editorFooter: sampled: editor bottom bar (zoom, issues, Ln/Ch)
controlBorder: sampled 2026-10-04: Solution Explorer search box, bottom stroke (sides #EAEAEA), as Dark takes its bottom stroke
lineNumberActive: Text Editor MEF Items.Selected Line Number
accent: Shell.AccentFillDefault (sampled on the focused window outline)
windowAccent: ShellInternal.EnvironmentBorder: focused-window outline and Solution Explorer selection pill (equals the accent here; the tinted themes change it)
selection: Text Editor MEF Items.Selected Text #5CA9E5 at 40%: VS draws its selection translucent
selectionInactive: composite: Text Editor MEF Items.Inactive Selected Text #D1D1D1 at 60% over editor
findMatch: sampled 2026-10-04: find matches, as drawn; VS marks the current match by selecting it (Dark draws its #773800 token as #453B32)
findMatchOther: sampled 2026-10-04: the non-current find matches, as drawn
bracketMatch: sampled 2026-10-04: matched braces, as drawn; the same fill as references, as in Dark
listSelection: sampled: Solution Explorer selected row; equals Shell.SubtleFillSecondary #0000000f over card
listSelectionInactive: sampled: VS keeps the same fill when Solution Explorer loses focus
listHover: composite: Shell.SubtleFillTertiary #0000000a over card (Fluent list hover)
fileGlyph: sampled: Solution Explorer monochrome file glyphs
squiggleWarning: VS default compiler warning (VS warnings are green)
squiggleInfo: Roslyn Text Editor MEF Items.inline diagnostics - Edit and Continue
inlayHintBg: Roslyn Text Editor MEF Items.inline hints background
inlayHintFg: Roslyn Text Editor MEF Items.inline hints foreground
indentGuide: sampled 2026-10-04: block structure guide lines, as drawn (solid in Light; Dark draws its #424242 token dotted)
snippetField: sampled 2026-10-04: an inactive snippet field, as drawn (Dark draws its #5B5B5B token as #4F4F4F)
unnecessaryOpacity: alpha only: VS fades unnecessary code to ~60%
debugCurrentGlyph: inferred: VS 2026 draws a two-tone arrow (cream fill, dark outline) over the breakpoint; VS Code's glyph has one colour, so it takes a yellow that reads on a white margin
debugFocused: sampled 2026-10-04: Call Return on the selected caller frame, #B9DFB9 as drawn, at 50% so the text stays readable
breakpointDisabled: inferred: VS 2026 draws a disabled breakpoint as a red hollow circle; VS Code's disabled glyph is a filled dot, which in red would look enabled, so it stays grey
diffAddLine: sampled 2026-10-07 in the diff view: added line, away from the caret (the 2026-10-04 value #E6EBDA was the caret line, under the current-line highlight)
diffAddWord: sampled 2026-10-04 in the diff view: added word
diffRemoveLine: sampled 2026-10-07 in the diff view: removed line, away from the caret (the 2026-10-04 value #F7CCCC was the caret line, under the current-line highlight)
diffRemoveWord: sampled 2026-10-04 in the diff view: removed word
gitConflict: inferred: orange between caution and critical
braceLevel1: Text Editor MEF Items.brace pair level one
braceLevel2: Text Editor MEF Items.brace pair level two
braceLevel3: Text Editor MEF Items.brace pair level three
synIdentifier: VS default Identifier: fields, properties, events, constants, enum members and namespaces stay plain
synDocAttribute: Roslyn.xml doc comment - attribute name / value
synType: Roslyn.class name / delegate name / module name
synMethod: Roslyn.method name / extension method name / operator - overloaded
synXmlQuote: sampled 2026-10-08: VS default XML Attribute Quotes, black while the value is blue
synXmlCData: sampled 2026-10-08: VS default XML CData Section
synHtmlAttribute: sampled 2026-10-03: VS default HTML Attribute Name, the same as XML
synCssVariable: sampled 2026-10-03: VS default SCSS / Less variable
synCssMixin: sampled 2026-10-03: VS default SCSS / Less mixin
synRazorDirective: sampled 2026-10-03: VS default Razor transition / directive (drawn on a #FFFFC2 server-code block)
synRazorDirectiveAttribute: sampled 2026-10-03: VS default Razor directive attribute
synRazorComponent: sampled 2026-10-03: VS default Razor component element / attribute
synSqlFunction: sampled 2026-10-03: VS default SQL System Function
synHeading: sampled 2026-10-04: Markdown headings take the class-name colour
